# Messages

Every message is an `Envelope` around one payload (DESIGN.md section 5). All models are
pydantic v2 and reject unknown fields.

## Routing table

| Payload | Recipient |
|---|---|
| CollectRequest | ['Collector'] |
| DocumentBatch | ['PreAnnotator', 'LLMAnnotator'] |
| Annotation | ['BoundaryNormalizer'] |
| NormalizedAnnotation | ['Verifier'] |
| VerificationResult | ['Evaluator'] |
| ReportRequest | ['Evaluator'] |
| EvaluationReport | ['Orchestrator'] |

## Envelope

### Envelope

The wrapper around every payload: who sent what to whom, and when.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| msg_id | `str` | no | uuid4 |
| run_id | `str` | yes | 'YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-xxxx' |
| step | `int` | yes | Number of the delivery in the run (1, 2, ...) |
| sender | `str` | yes | Agent that produced the payload |
| recipient | `str` | yes | Agent that receives it (from the routing table) |
| type | `str` | yes | Class name of the payload |
| created_at | `datetime` | no | UTC, ISO-8601 in JSON |
| payload | `union[CollectRequest, DocumentBatch, Annotation, NormalizedAnnotation, VerificationResult, ReportRequest, EvaluationReport]` | yes | One of the payload models below |

## Payloads

### CollectRequest

Orchestrator -> Collector: what text to fetch and how to batch it.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| source | `Literal['wikipedia', 'file', 'kaznerd_test']` | yes | Where the text comes from (kaznerd_test: A4) |
| title | `str \| None` | no | Wikipedia article title |
| path | `str \| None` | no | Path of a UTF-8 text file |
| max_sentences | `int` | no | Stop after this many |
| batch_size | `int` | no | Sentences per batch |
| seed | `int` | no | Seed of the kaznerd_test sample |

### DocumentBatch

Collector -> annotators: a batch of sentences with provenance.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| batch_id | `str` | yes | e.g. 'b001'; unique within a run |
| doc_id | `str` | yes | e.g. 'kkwiki-абай-құнанбайұлы' |
| source_url | `str` | yes | Article URL, or 'file:<name>' for a local file |
| licence | `str` | yes | Licence of the source text, e.g. 'CC BY-SA 4.0' |
| sentences | `list[Sentence]` | yes |  |

### Annotation

Annotator -> BoundaryNormalizer: entities for every sentence of a batch.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| batch_id | `str` | yes |  |
| annotator | `Literal['mbert', 'llm']` | yes | Which annotator produced it |
| sentences | `list[SentenceAnnotation]` | yes |  |

### NormalizedAnnotation

BoundaryNormalizer -> Verifier (one annotator: Evaluator): valid IOB2 labels per word.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| batch_id | `str` | yes |  |
| annotator | `Literal['mbert', 'llm']` | yes |  |
| sentences | `list[SentenceLabels]` | yes |  |
| repairs_applied | `int` | yes | Number of repairs in the whole batch |

### VerificationResult

Verifier -> Evaluator: final labels and a decision for every compared region.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| batch_id | `str` | yes |  |
| sentences | `list[SentenceVerdict]` | yes |  |

### ReportRequest

Orchestrator -> Evaluator, once after the last batch: score the whole run.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| batch_ids | `list[str]` | yes | Batches that finished with an EvaluationReport |

### EvaluationReport

Evaluator -> Orchestrator: quality numbers for a batch (or the whole run) and the files.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| batch_id | `str` | yes | The batch, or 'run' for the report on the whole run |
| mode | `Literal['gold', 'agreement', 'summary']` | yes |  |
| precision | `float \| None` | no | Final labels against gold |
| recall | `float \| None` | no |  |
| f1 | `float \| None` | no |  |
| agreement_rate | `float \| None` | no | Entity-level F1 of one annotator against the other |
| per_annotator | `dict[str, dict[str, float]]` | no | Gold mode: precision/recall/f1 of each annotator |
| counts | `dict[str, int]` | no |  |
| export_paths | `list[str]` | no |  |

## Building blocks

### Sentence

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| sentence_id | `str` | yes | Unique id, e.g. 'kk-wiki-abai-s0003' |
| words | `list[str]` | yes | The sentence split into words |
| gold_labels | `list[str] \| None` | no | Gold IOB2 labels (only for the kaznerd_test source, A4) |

### Span

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| start_word | `int` | yes | Index of the first word (inclusive) |
| end_word | `int` | yes | Index of the last word (inclusive) |
| type | `EntityType (25 KazNERD types)` | yes | One of the 25 KazNERD entity types |
| text | `str \| None` | no | The words of the span, for checking |

### SentenceAnnotation

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| sentence_id | `str` | yes |  |
| words | `list[str]` | yes |  |
| entities | `list[Span] \| None` | no | Spans (LLM annotator) |
| labels | `list[str] \| None` | no | IOB2 labels (mBERT, A4) |
| notes | `list[str]` | no | Problems seen by the annotator |

### SentenceLabels

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| sentence_id | `str` | yes |  |
| words | `list[str]` | yes |  |
| labels | `list[str]` | yes | Valid IOB2 labels, one per word |
| repairs | `list[str]` | no | What the normaliser fixed |

### Decision

How the Verifier settled one region where the two annotations were compared.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| start_word | `int` | yes | First word of the region |
| end_word | `int` | yes | Last word of the region (inclusive) |
| decision | `Literal['agreed', 'adjudicated', 'escalated']` | yes |  |
| kept | `Literal['mbert', 'llm', 'both', 'neither']` | yes | Whose labels the final annotation keeps for this region |
| rationale | `str` | yes | Why: 'both annotators agree', a rule, or the LLM's reason |

### SentenceVerdict

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| sentence_id | `str` | yes |  |
| words | `list[str]` | yes |  |
| labels | `list[str]` | yes | Final IOB2 labels |
| decisions | `list[Decision]` | no |  |
